name_zh: 弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世/奥地利/哈布斯堡/二元君主/一战/帝国解体/长寿
description_zh: 弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世（1830-1916），奥匈帝国皇帝（1848-1916），哈布斯堡王朝第68代皇帝，二元君主制创始人，长期执政，为欧洲最长寿领导人之一，领导奥匈帝国度过危机时期，推行温和改革，管理多民族帝国，一战爆发后支持参战，最终导致帝国解体，退位成为奥地利公爵。
description_en: Franz Joseph I (1830-1916), Emperor of Austria (1848-1916), 68th ruler of Habsburg dynasty, founder of dual monarchy, long-term ruler, one of Europe's longest-serving leaders, led Austro-Hungarian Empire through crisis periods, implemented moderate reforms, managed multi-ethnic empire, supported WWI participation after outbreak, eventually led to imperial disintegration, abdicated became Austrian Duke.
reason_zh: 弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世是奥匈帝国历史中最具象征意义的人物，他跨越了漫长的哈布斯堡统治时期，建立二元君主制，并在一战前后见证了帝国从强盛走向最终崩溃。
reason_en: Franz Joseph I is the most iconic figure in Austro-Hungarian history, spanning a long Habsburg reign, establishing the dual monarchy, and witnessing the empire's transition from strength to its eventual collapse around WWI.
steps_zh: 继位与改革：1848 革命继位/帝国统一/君主立宪尝试/二元君主制构想/君主威权
二元体系建立：1867 协定/奥地利-匈牙利联合/双重帝国/民族自治平衡/君主制稳定
帝国扩张与稳定：1870s 现代化改革/管理多民族平衡/维持帝国稳定/长期执政
一战与解体：1914 萨拉热窝/参战决定/一战冲突/帝国疲惫/1916 逝世/帝国崩溃/结局
遗产与意义：1848-1916 统治/帝国记忆/哈布斯堡传统/奥地利政治根基/历史反思
steps_en: Succession & Reform: 1848 revolution succession/imperial unity/constitutional attempts/dual monarchy concept/monarchic authority
Dual system establishment: 1867 Compromise/Austria-Hungary union/dual empire/ethnic autonomy balance/monarchy stability
Imperial expansion & stability: 1870s modernization reforms/managing multi-ethnic balance/maintaining stability/long reign
WWI & Disintegration: 1914 Sarajevo/war declaration/WWI conflict/imperial exhaustion/1916 death/collapse/outcome
Legacy & significance: 1848-1916 reign/imperial memory/Habsburg tradition/Austrian political roots/historical reflection
expected_zh: 构建奥匈帝国多民族帝国的君主统治范式，通过二元君主制维持长期的多民族帝国管理，反映哈布斯堡王朝在近代民族国家挑战下的崩溃过程。
expected_en: Built the monarchical governance paradigm for a multi-ethnic empire, maintained long-term management through the dual monarchy, reflecting the Habsburg collapse under the challenges of modern nation-states.
